meta.description: A three-lane automation diagram: web, maps and AI sources on the left, a settings card in the middle, and the agents and booked confirmation they produce on the right. Elbow connectors are generated from the same coordinate table the nodes are placed from, and every measurement is a fraction of the panel's own width, so type, icons and toggles keep their proportions at any size. Static — no hooks, no motion, zero JavaScript.
